description.value: Di Beppe is an Italian caffè and ristorante in Vancouver's Gastown neighbourhood, self-described as 'a young Italian restaurant with an old Italian soul.' The front caffè room serves morning espresso and transitions into a wine bar by evening, also housing a deli, pastry shop, and retail market — all in one warm space. Part of the KT Restaurants group, the menu spans antipasti, house-made pasta, Neapolitan-style pizza, and a daily aperitivo hour.
